name: Newmont
description: Newmont is the world's largest gold miner by its own account, with mines in the US, Papua New Guinea, Australia, Ghana, Suriname, Argentina, Dominican Republic (40% of Pueblo Viejo), Peru, Mexico and Canada, plus a 32% stake in Lundin Gold's Fruta del Norte (Ecuador). It digs ore, processes it to dore bars or metal concentrates, and sells gold and by-product copper, silver, lead and zinc at market prices, so revenue equals ounces sold times the spot price and profit is what is left after mining costs; the realized gold price was $4,661 per ounce in H1 2026 against $3,128 a year earlier. 85% of FY2025 sales were gold. After buying Newcrest in November 2023 it sold six non-core mines and a project (completed by Q4 2025) and now spends most of its free cash on buybacks and a dividend.

gics.note: Conventional filing label: GICS Sector 'Materials' and Sub-Industry 'Gold' per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-09-30). That list gives only Sector and Sub-Industry, so industry group and industry are null (not sourced). SEC SIC code 1040 (Gold and Silver Ores) per EDGAR.

hq.note: 6900 E Layton Ave, Suite 700, Denver, CO 80237 (EDGAR business address); Delaware corporation incorporated 1921 (FY2025 10-K)

employees.note: About 17,500 employees plus about 26,600 contractors (FY2025 10-K); about 27% of the workforce is unionised or in collective bargaining

businessLines.name: Nevada Gold Mines (NGM), 38.5% proportionate interest, US
businessLines.how: Sells gold as dore and concentrate at the spot price; Newmont books its 38.5% share of sales and costs, so profit depends on the gold price and Barrick's operating results. Newmont has told Barrick it found evidence of mismanagement at NGM (Q1 2026) and is exercising audit rights.
businessLines.description: Gold operations in Nevada run by Barrick (Newmont holds 38.5% and does not manage it). Reported as a segment on a proportionate basis.

operatingProfit.note: Segment income before income and mining tax and other items

businessLines.name: Peñasquito, Mexico
businessLines.how: Sells lead and zinc concentrates to smelters (which take a treatment charge) and dore to refiners; about half of sales are silver, lead and zinc, so silver price matters as much as gold here (realized silver $61.51/oz in H1 2026 vs $29.80).
businessLines.description: Polymetallic mine producing gold, silver, lead and zinc, with sales in concentrate and dore.

operatingProfit.note: Segment income before income and mining tax and other items

businessLines.name: Cadia, Australia
businessLines.how: Sells gold dore and a gold/copper concentrate to smelters; copper counts as a co-product, so copper price and gold price both drive revenue.
businessLines.description: Gold and copper mine in New South Wales; underground mining halted by a seismic event on April 14, 2026.

operatingProfit.note: Segment income before income and mining tax and other items

businessLines.name: Ahafo South, Ghana
businessLines.how: Sells gold dore to refiners at the spot price; profit is the gold price less mine costs and government royalty and taxes.

operatingProfit.note: Segment income before income and mining tax and other items

businessLines.name: Boddington, Australia
businessLines.how: Sells gold dore plus copper concentrate to smelters; gold is about 89% of its sales.

businessLines.name: Lihir, Papua New Guinea
businessLines.how: Sells gold dore to refiners; costs per ounce rose 14% in H1 2026 on lower ounces and stockpile-fed inventory costs.

businessLines.name: Yanacocha, Peru
businessLines.how: Sells gold dore at the spot price; margin is lower than peers because of reclamation charges (FY2025 segment income is after $784M of other items).

businessLines.name: Tanami, Australia
businessLines.how: Sells gold dore at the spot price.

businessLines.name: Merian, Suriname
businessLines.how: Sells gold dore at the spot price.

businessLines.name: Brucejack, Canada
businessLines.how: Sells gold in dore and concentrate at the spot price.

businessLines.name: Cerro Negro, Argentina
businessLines.how: Sells gold dore at the spot price.

businessLines.name: Red Chris, Canada
businessLines.how: Sells copper-gold concentrate to smelters; copper is the larger part of its sales.

businessLines.name: Ahafo North, Ghana
businessLines.how: Sells gold dore at the spot price.
businessLines.description: New mine; declared commercial production October 2025.

operatingProfit.note: Segment income before income and mining tax and other items; includes a $29M other-segment income item (sales 242 less costs 31, D&A 10, exploration 7 plus 29)

brands.name: Divested mines with FY2025 sales (CC&V, Musselwhite, Porcupine, Éléonore, Akyem); Telfer sold Q4 2024 and Coffee project sold Q4 2025
brands.share: $628M of FY2025 sales (about 2.8% of $22,669M) before their sale

brands.name: Pueblo Viejo, Dominican Republic (40%, equity method)
brands.share: 253 thousand attributable ounces FY2025 (4.3% of 5,889 thousand attributable ounces)

brands.name: Fruta del Norte, Ecuador (32% of Lundin Gold, equity method)
brands.share: 165 thousand attributable ounces FY2025 (2.8% of attributable ounces)
